definition: when something passes from one state to another
description: From the top of wooden beach steps, two hands in a knitted cardigan hold up an old printed picture of a sunny sandy beach with a small blue hut on stilts and people on the sand. Behind it the same coast now looks completely different: the sand is gone, grey waves smash against black rocks, and a broken hut lies on the rocks. A man and a woman in a yellow raincoat lean on a hut balcony and look down. Then one hand lowers the picture and holds up a steaming mug under a stormy evening sky.

taps.phrase: to hold up an old photograph
to point at the wrecked hut
